title: InvSwap
body:
InvSwap is client side mod that adds a key to swap your inventory and hotbar.   
Swap slots 27 to 35 in your inventory with slots 0 to 8 on your hotbar.   
Press `Mouse Button 4` to swap.   
You can change swap key in key bind settings menu.

Available in singleplayer and multiplayer.
